# ViraStack

> Modern web tools and architecture in one stack: production-ready starters, accessible React utilities, and agent-ready project setup without configuration fatigue.

ViraStack is an open-source ecosystem (MIT) for building modern React apps. Prefer product docs for API detail; use this file as a curated map.

## Products

- [Start](https://virastack.com/start): CLI to scaffold production-ready Next.js or TanStack Start projects.
- [Mask](https://virastack.com/mask): React Hook Form–friendly input masking (`@virastack/mask`).
- [Password](https://virastack.com/password): Accessible password visibility toggle (`@virastack/password`).
- [AI](https://virastack.com/ai): Agent rules, skills, and architecture kit (`@virastack/ai`).
- [Guide](https://virastack.com/guide): Interactive “modern web in 3 minutes” experience.

## Documentation

- [Start docs](https://virastack.com/start/docs): Install CLI, flags, and templates.
- [Start llms.txt](https://virastack.com/start/llms.txt): Machine-readable Start index.
- [Mask docs](https://virastack.com/mask/docs): useViraMask, presets, validation, examples.
- [Mask llms.txt](https://virastack.com/mask/llms.txt): Machine-readable Mask index.
- [Password docs](https://virastack.com/password/docs): useViraPassword, accessibility, customization.
- [Password llms.txt](https://virastack.com/password/llms.txt): Machine-readable Password index.

## Packages

- [`virastack`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/virastack): Project scaffold CLI.
- [`@virastack/mask`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/mask): Input masks for React + React Hook Form.
- [`@virastack/password`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/password): Password visibility hook for React.
- [`@virastack/ai`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/ai): Shared agent rules and docs for scaffolds.
